title: Fig Props Up the Nest
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 63-sound stage (pr, sc, sk just added).

pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar spotting a small twig nest resting unevenly on a branch.

pages.text: The nest is on a twig. It is not flat.
pages.illustration: Close view of the nest tilted at an angle on the branch, not sitting flat.

pages.text: Fig props a stick under it.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar wedging a thin stick underneath the tilted nest.
The nest tipping sideways off the thin stick.
Fig the caterpillar finding a flat grey rock on the ground.

pages.text: Fig props the rock under the nest.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar wedging the flat grey rock underneath the nest instead.
The nest now resting flat and steady on the branch.

pages.text: Fig can skip up to it.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar climbing nimbly up to the now-steady nest.
Fig the caterpillar curled up asleep inside the steady nest.
